text:
Alex (devex): FYI I hit a confusing failure while walking through the Next.js + LangChain sample app. onboarding was fine, then requests started failing after our test token rotated.
Noor (eng-runtime): what kind of failures? 401/403 or retries causing rate limits?
Alex (devex): first hit is 401, then the browser/server code retries aggressively and we see a flurry of 429s from the backend. starter uses the SDK default so users are literally DDOSing their own plugin on token expiry.
Kai (eng-ml): is this on Edge or Node SSR? behavior differs because Edge handlers can't easily mutate server sessions in-flight.
Alex (devex): Edge. sample's server action calls /api/chat which proxies to the LangChain agent. the agent process returns 401 when RW token is rotated.
Maya (docs): users copy paste the sample and won't think about refresh hooks. we should make the starter explicit.
Noor (eng-runtime): agreed. proposal: change SDK defaults for edge contexts to conservative retries (retries: 1) and expose `retryOn` config that ignores 401 and calls an `onRefresh` hook. also add middleware example to the Next starter that refreshes cookie/session before retry.
Alex (devex): like this snippet in api/chat.js: 
```
// minimal server proxy (api/chat.js)
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY,
  retries: 1,
  retryOn: (status) => status !== 401
})
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const attempt = await client.request(req.body)
  if (attempt.status === 401) {
    // try a single refresh and replay
    await refreshServerSession(req)
    return client.request(req.body)
  }
  return res.json(await attempt.json())
}
```
Kai (eng-ml): good. but prefer we surface a helper `withAuthRefresh(handler, opts)` in the starter so folks don't implement ad-hoc logic that varies.
Noor (eng-runtime): agreed. I'll add a tiny middleware util in samples/next-starters: `lib/withAuthRefresh.js` that runs refresh on 401 once and backoffs if the token still fails.
Maya (docs): I'll add a short blurb to the quickstart: "Edge runtimes + rotated API keys: use withAuthRefresh to avoid hot retry storms."
Alex (devex): can we also add a unit in the eval harness that simulates a token expiry mid-stream and asserts only one refresh attempt? we've seen this turn into flaky customer issues.
Noor (eng-runtime): CI-bot: please add a flaky test step `samples-next:auth-refresh-guard` that injects a 401 on the first proxied call and verifies client behavior.
Test-bot: added pipeline job `samples-next:auth-refresh-guard` to sample-app workflows.
Kai (eng-ml): runtime change: add `onAuthRefresh` hook to SDK constructor signature and make SDK skip automatic retries for 401s if hook present. fallback to previous behavior if hook omitted. I'll file issue and draft PR.
Noor (eng-runtime): also log a metric `auth_refresh.attempt` so we can see how often sample apps hit this in production. opt-in telemetry only.
Maya (docs): tiny UX note: mention cookie path and SameSite issues in the middleware example; Edge deployments often use different domains and cookies silently fail.
Alex (devex): good catch. I'll update the sample README with explicit cookie guidance + the middleware snippet.
Noor (eng-runtime): once PRs are up ping me. I'll ensure the SDK change is gated behind a minor release and a feature flag so we can monitor.
Alex (devex): thanks team — this should save a lot of confused users. I'll open the sample PR and link it here.
Alex (devex): PR: https://git.redwood.example/samples/next-starters/pull/102 (adds withAuthRefresh util, README example, and eval harness test)
Noor (eng-runtime): quick review left on the PR. one nit about test timing.
Maya (docs): updated quickstart draft in the PR with a short troubleshooting checklist.
Test-bot: `samples-next:auth-refresh-guard` ran on the branch and passed.
Alex (devex): merged. closing thread — follow-up: add a one-paragraph note in the SDK changelog about the new hook and default backoff for edge contexts.
Kai (eng-ml): I'll handle changelog entry and a short migration note.
